subject: Forecast integrity: close-date & stage remediation
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 08:13:00 -0700
Subject: Forecast integrity: close-date & stage remediation

Team —

Attached is a quick export (stale-opps-export-20270521.csv) of opportunities flagged by the forecast hygiene rule: last_activity >= 60 days and close_date moved >30 days from last commit. Finance flagged a handful that are still in "Commit" but show no recent engagement. To keep our May forecast meaningful we need the following from each AE below by EOD Tuesday, 24 May (PT):

- Review every opp in your book in the CSV.
- For each opp, update: Stage, Close Date (if you truly expect movement), and the custom field "Commit?" (Yes/No).
- If an opp is genuinely stale, move to "At Risk" or "Disqualified" and add one line why.
- If you need help with paperwork/procurement blockers, cc the customer contact and marissa_cole so we can triage.

Why this matters: Finance will lock the forecast refresh on 25 May. If we leave stale commit dollars in, our burn/coverage math will be off and it increases the chance of a scramble at quarter close.

Quick notes:
- I've added a saved list view in Salesforce for the export: https://salesforce.com/00B0y00000ExampleListView
- If an opp is large ($250k+) and you think it will slip, flag it in the comments and escalate to Evelyn for forecasting guidance.

Thanks — please reply with a one-line ack and the date you'll complete updates.

—
Michael Grant
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: stale-opps-export-20270521.csv (csv, 24 KB)
